messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary reassignment of dedicated GPU slots + autoscale waiver

Team —

Quick context: NimbleCart is kicking off a customer demo next Tuesday (internal dry-run Mon AM) and their production traffic profile for the demo will need ~2x our usual prod-slot peak for a 48-hour window. They asked if we can move two reserved GPUs currently assigned to the *staging-east-2* slice into *prod-east-2* for the window and suspend the normal autoscale eviction policy for that slice during the event to avoid cold-starts.

What I'm asking for:
- Ops: Can we reassign 2x A100-equivalent slots from staging -> prod for 48 hours starting 2028-05-22 06:00 UTC?
- Infra: Can we approve a temporary autoscale waiver (no preemption) for the prod slice during that window and pre-warm KV caches?
- Product/Finance: Kimberly/Laura — can you confirm we green-light this from a customer-priority + cost perspective (I've attached a rough cost estimate)?

Constraints noted so far: the slots are not currently in a burst lane and will need a rebind; rebind needs 24–36h lead time to avoid scheduler churn. If ops and infra sign off today we can hit the proposed start.

Attachments: pool-transfer-plan.xlsx (allocation + timing), cost-estimate-48h.pdf

If we can't move the physical slots, alternate ask is to reserve burst capacity + pre-warm and hand NimbleCart a temporary higher priority band for the demo. Suggest approvals by EOD — NimbleCart wants final confirmation tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Success Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-05-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reassignment of dedicated GPU slots + autoscale waiver

Thanks for the heads up, Olga. A few clarifying questions before I can sign off:

1) Is this reassignment expected to impact any other active pilots in *staging-east-2*? We have two pilots scheduled this week and we need to ensure no regressions.
2) The cost estimate looks reasonable but we need to confirm whether NimbleCart will accept a temporary surcharge or if Redwood will absorb for the demo. Laura, can you weigh in on whether finance can approve a trade credit or formal amendment?
3) What are the rollback conditions? If the customer load is below threshold, can we return slots early without penalty?

If infra confirms the technical feasibility and we get a cost decision from finance, I'll approve the reassignment. Also please include the runbook snippet that operators will use during the window — I want a short checklist we can share with the account team.

On the pilots: if reassigning the two slots would cause a >15% perf degradation for any active staging pilot, we should instead use a burst lane.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reassignment of dedicated GPU slots + autoscale waiver

Olga / team —

Short answer: feasible but with operational caveats. Details below.

Operational plan (high level):
- Rebind path: we can reassign 2x A100-equivalent slots from staging-east-2 to prod-east-2. Scheduler change requires draining and remapping; estimate 24–36 hours if done during low-traffic window.
- Autoscale waiver: we can toggle the preemption policy per-slice. We'll set a temporary policy that disables eviction for the prod slice and enable it back at end-of-window.
- Pre-warm: recommended — KV cache priming + model weights cache. Prewarm will add ~6–8 minutes per instance; will perform in parallel once slots are re-assigned. See attached prewarm-checklist.txt for steps.
- Rollback: yes — early return possible. We'll annotate the operation with a rollback tag and a canary stream to watch token latency and GPU util. If latency rises >20% or error rate >1% for 10m, we'll initiate rollback.

Constraints / risks:
- Staging impact: reassigning will reduce staging capacity by ~30% for the two affected training/test queues; I recommend rescheduling any heavy batch sims out of the 48h window.
- Scheduler churn: frequent rebinds to the same physical pool cause kernel warm/cool cycles — limit repeated reassignments.
- Marketplace pilots: if there's a marketplace pilot pinned to those exact slot IDs, we need to coordinate with Markus/Marketplace team (not on this thread) — I can check if any such pins exist.

Time: If you want the move to start 2028-05-22 06:00 UTC we need sign-off by EOD 2028-05-19 so we can begin draining tonight. Ops can run the rebind overnight.

Attaching: prewarm-checklist.txt

- Dev
Dev Patel
SRE/Infra, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: temporary reassignment of dedicated GPU slots + autoscale waiver

Thanks all — aligning next steps here and capturing approvals.

Kimberly: noted on pilot impact. Per Dev, staging will drop ~30% in capacity for those queues — I've messaged the staging owners and rescheduled a batch sim that was planned for Tuesday night.

Laura: can finance confirm whether NimbleCart will cover the incremental cost or if Redwood issues a demo credit? If we need a PO, procurement@nimbecart.com is CC'd.

Dev: please proceed with the rebind plan once we have finance confirmation. Ops should run the prewarm after rebind and monitor the canary stream. Use rollback conditions Dev listed.

NimbleCart: this is the plan we propose for the demo window (2028-05-22 06:00 UTC -> 2028-05-24 06:00 UTC). We will provide hourly perf notes during the window and an after-action summary. If anything changes we will notify you immediately.

Final asks / owners: 
- Approve rebind + autoscale waiver: Kimberly (product) — please OK explicitly in reply.
- Finance confirmation (charge vs credit): Laura (finance/procurement) — please advise.
- Infra operational run: Dev (infra) / Aditya (ops) — please run rebind + prewarm and monitor.

If we get these approvals by 18:00 PT today I will confirm to NimbleCart and ops will schedule the rebind for tonight.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Success Lead, Redwood Inference
